Says a shrunk failing sequence becomes a plain replay test and the regressions file is committed

Suggests checking that the operation strategy actually generates every kind of step (each operation, existing and missing ids, expired sessions), for example by sampling whole sequences with a fixed seed and classifying each step against the model
